summary: EveryDocs is a lightweight document management system designed to help individuals digitise and organise personal paperwork. It provides a central repository for storing files, though the specific indexing and search capabilities are basic. The project is implemented in Ruby and distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a straightforward, self-hosted archive for personal paperwork without the complexity of enterprise document management software.
watchOut: The project has an infrequent release schedule and low maintenance activity, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack security updates over time.
deployNotes: As a Dockerised Ruby application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for file storage and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
